value.rationale: The question asks exactly which partial point-image assignments in a finite classical group support all Boolean labels. The result identifies an explicit pure nonmatroidal two-vector-matroid intersection and supplies its all-dimensional face enumerator, going substantially beyond the scalar VC dimension; the GL3 homology rank 3870 captures topology of a natural 49-query complex. These are canonical invariants suitable for further comparisons of permutation group actions, not an arbitrary slice of a count.
